Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Ed Sheeran as the host of the 16th Annual Young Hollywood Awards. The visible portion of the search results, particularly the Wikipedia entry, clearly states that Kelly Osbourne hosted the event, not Ed Sheeran.
